title.value: False, misleading, and unfounded statements in a recent TPAMI publication

TLDR.value: We refute a recent paper that extensively misquotes a prior paper with actual text from the prior paper.

abstract.value:
A recent TPAMI response raises issues with the contents of a recent
TPAMI comment and the data collection underlying that comment.
Several of the claims in that response are unfounded, inaccurate,
misleading, false, invalid, or unsupported, as demonstrated by text in
the comment and cited work, and new analyses that we report.  The
response further ignores key components of the work that it responds
to.
